statement: For arbitrary E/Q, U=E-E[N], and nontorsion rational R, let a have finitely many zero coefficient components and suppose some prime lambda divides v_p(a_p) for all but finitely many nonzero components. Then abelian Selmer lifting of a*kappa(R) is equivalent to a being a nonzero integer, with unique point-section fibre. The same exponent set holds metabelianly.
depends_on: A.65; A.64; full local Kummer injectivity; four-simple-point elliptic boundary units and their translates; formal logarithm over unramified local fields; S-unit theorem and finite class group; Faltings1983 Satz7 with1984 correction
answers: A.12 and Lead5: a new explicit infinite-nonunit-support exclusion, including a_p=p^r for every p and every r>=2, and every nonintegral componentwise prime-power exponent with finite zero set; uniform for every elliptic cubic twist and arbitrary E/Q
notes: The infinite-positive-valuation contradiction works over every number field, uses no CM or finite-Sha hypothesis, and allows lambda dividing N. Simple-pole translated units directly force cusp distances modulo lambda; rational points n_jR with n_j ordinary lambda-th powers dividing a transfer these constraints because the formal distance shift is v_q(a_q)-v_q(n_j), a nonnegative lambda multiple outside one fixed finite S. The four-point Kummer covers have genus2lambda-1. Both root and B independently audited the complete proof. Infinite zero sets and profiles with infinitely many valuations nonzero modulo every lambda remain outside this theorem; actual metabelian fibres and congruence-cover comparisons remain separate.
